title: LEVEL 1 SUBSAFE MATERIAL CABLE CUTTER AND REELING MACHINE ASSEMBLY COMPONENTS
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NSWC PHILADELPHIA DIV
detail_text: The contractor shall fabricate, conduct certification testing, and deliver material components for the Cable Cutter and Reeling Machine Assembly. All material components are LEVEL I Material and/or Material to be installed in a SUBSAFE Boundary. The purpose of this amendment is to 1. Amend the page limits on the table in section L.3 2. Delete the table footer language: The entire Technical proposal (excluding cost or otherwise noted) shall not exceed twenty(20) pages in length. 3. Extend the due date to 12 March 2026.All other terms and conditions remain unchanged.
